change.finding: The prior review-only 0031 generator described a multi-statement REST query as one atomic operation, although that API request's transaction semantics had not been established.
change.implementation: Replaced the multi-statement REST request with four individually rerunnable CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS statements plus a fifth guarded marker insert. Each trigger stays dormant until the marker exists. The final statement requires the exact 36-marker baseline through 0030, 11 archive triggers, and exact stored SQL for each of the four definitions (not just matching names), plus a clean foreign-key check.
